title: F126.3.4 start, follow and stop a run: the overview
caption: Five parts: the judge's cost on each turn, an estimate asked of the eval's row, a run that can be stopped, the card that starts a run after asking, and the run page that follows it.

cards.title: F126.3.4 A run from the admin
cards.text: A person starts a run from an eval's card, follows it as it plays, and stops it, knowing what it costs.

cards.title: Judge's cost
cards.text: Each turn keeps what judging it cost, beside what the agent cost.

cards.title: An estimate
cards.text: From what the last live run spent. Not known is said, never 0.

cards.title: A run stops
cards.text: At once. The run ends as stopped and keeps what it graded.

cards.title: The card asks
cards.text: Replay free starts at once. Run live asks first, with the cost on its button.

cards.title: Page follows
cards.text: It reads the run every three seconds while it goes, and holds Stop.
